title: Meta Account & Infrastructure Manager (Internal Structures)
description:
Remote · part-time · DTC ecommerce



We're a multi-brand DTC company scaling daily on Meta across several markets. Growth lives and dies on the structure behind the ads — so this role owns the internal side of Meta: the infrastructure that keeps us scaling. Healthy ad accounts, clean pages, working tracking, and a setup that holds up when Meta gets strict.



This is not creatives and not media buying. It's the back-end machine that lets the rest of the team run. If you understand how Business Manager actually works under the hood — and you like keeping a complex system clean — keep reading.



What you'll do:



Ad accounts

Anticipate capacity needs and request new ad accounts before we hit limits.

Warm up new accounts properly so they're stable before they carry real spend.

Run engagement campaigns to keep assets active and healthy.





Pages & setups

Set up new pages end to end — name, profile, details — without tripping disallowed words or policy.

Stand up new setups cleanly: connect pixels to ad accounts, link pixels to WeTracked, and share ad accounts to the right profiles.





Structure & health

Keep the structure fresh and resilient — never more than 2 restricted profiles per group.

Organize how accounts and profiles are shared so nothing becomes a single point of failure.

Stay on top of Meta's policy shifts and adjust the structure before they bite.





Documentation & moderation

Keep our Miro board matching the live structure at all times.

Moderate comments across all ads and ~30 pages daily — plan for real daily time on this.





What you need

Hands-on experience with Meta's internal structures — Business Manager, profiles, ad accounts, pages. Non-negotiable.

A real grip on account warming, restrictions, and keeping a structure ban-resistant.

Experience connecting pixels with WeTracked (or a server-side / CAPI tool you can adapt from).

Organized, reliable and detail-obsessed — this is recurring daily ops, so consistency beats flair.

Able to work independently and own your area with minimal hand-holding.

Solid written English; comfortable in Miro (or quick to learn).





Nice to have

Experience inside a DTC / ecommerce media-buying operation.

Worked across multiple markets or languages.





The honest reality

This is an infrastructure/ops role, not creatives or media buying — repetitive by nature. The wins are quiet: nothing breaks, accounts stay live, tracking just works. If you love keeping a complex machine running and take pride in a clean structure, you'll thrive. If you want to build creatives or scale budgets, this isn't your seat.



Details & applying

Type: part-time · Remote · Pay: $4–4.50 / hour · Start: ASAP

To apply: send your resume and a short motivation. Start your message with "Banana", plus a few lines on your Meta BM experience and any pixel/WeTracked setups you've built.

title: Automation & Systems Specialist - Remote (Part-Time / Project-Based)
description:
Flexible hours | Remote | Microsoft 365, Power Platform & Workflow Automation



If you enjoy turning messy, manual workflows into clean automated systems, and you like solving real operational problems, this could be a good fit.



Platinum Healthcare has been supporting Perth communities since 2006. We work across NDIS, aged care, Support at Home, recruitment, and business support. Our coordinators handle a high volume of
: clinical notes from external providers, task requests, and automatic alerts from our scheduling and client management system. We want to automate the triage, summarising, record-keeping, and filing of that
 so coordinators spend less time on noise and more time on clients.

This is a part-time or project-based role. We are not sure we have enough work to keep someone busy full-time, so we want someone who can scope, build, document, and hand over a working system, then stay available for the next phase. You will design and build the automations yourself, not just advise.



What This Role Is Really Like

This is a build role, not a pure advisory one.

You will look at how
 and alerts currently flow to our coordinators, design a better process, and build it in our Microsoft 365 environment. You will work under our governance: we control the credentials, the environment access, and any write-back to live client records. You build inside that, document what you build, and train us to run it.

The work blends:

• workflow design and process mapping

• Power Automate flow building

• AI-based classification and summarisation

• API and custom connector integration

• documentation and handover



The Work

A current example of what we want built:

• Coordinators receive every
 and system alert in one inbox. We want each new message classified: does the coordinator need to do anything, is there a deterioration or input request, what is the urgency.

• We want a short, clear summary produced for the coordinator on items that need action.

• Where an
 is an external clinical update, we want a note or document created in the matching client record in our system (Sandwai) via its API.

• Once an
 is processed, we want it moved to an archive folder automatically.

• We want a manual-review path for anything the automation cannot match or classify with confidence, so nothing is written to the wrong client.

You would design this as a staged build: a quick win first (triage and summary), then system integration, then governance and audit controls. We expect you to recommend the right sequence.



What We're Looking For

• Strong, demonstrated experience building automations in Microsoft Power Automate

• Experience with Microsoft 365 and Outlook / shared mailbox automation

• Experience calling REST APIs and building or configuring custom connectors

• Experience using AI / prompt-based steps for text classification and summarisation (AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or similar)

• Able to design a sensible process, not just wire up tools

• Clear documentation and handover skills, so we can run and maintain what you build

• Comfortable working within client governance and least-privilege access, especially around health data

• Able to work independently, scope your own work, and manage priorities remotely

• Copilot Studio, Dataverse, or SharePoint experience is an advantage

• Healthcare, NDIS, aged care, or compliance exposure is advantageous but not essential



Hours & Structure

• Part-time or project-based, remote

• Hours flexible and scoped to the work in front of us

• Initial engagement is to scope and build the
 automation described above

• Ongoing or repeat work likely for the right person as we automate more workflows



What We Offer

• Remote work flexibility

• Clearly defined projects with real operational impact

• Supportive and approachable leadership

• Direct communication and a team that values your contribution

• A pipeline of further automation work as systems mature



How to Apply

Please apply with:

• Your CV/resume

• A short cover letter about your background

In your cover letter, please answer the following:

• Describe an automation you built end to end in Power Automate. What problem did it solve, and how did you handle errors or exceptions?

• Have you integrated a third-party system via API or custom connector? Tell us what and how.

• This role involves health-related client data. How do you approach handling sensitive data and working within someone else's access controls?

• This is part-time or project-based rather than ongoing full-time. What interests you about that kind of arrangement?

If possible, don’t use ChatGPT, even just to correct your grammar. It may make your application sound cleaner, but it also makes you blend in with other applicants who don’t really have the skills and are relying on ChatGPT to prepare their answer.



Don’t worry about perfect wording. I care more about real details. The more details you go into, the easier it is for me to see that you actually did the work and that I can trust you with this.



If you’ve read this far, I hope you’re the right person for us.

title: Operations Leader
description:
Aqua Home Supply

Job Posting — June 2026



Operations Leader — E-Commerce (Remote, Full-Time)

Company: Aqua Home Supply

Location: Remote (Philippines-based preferred)

Schedule: Full-time | Must overlap with US Central Time business hours



About Aqua Home Supply

Aqua Home Supply is a US-based e-commerce company specializing in water filtration, purification, and softener systems. We sell through our Shopify storefront and fulfill orders through a network of US suppliers. Our team is small, remote, and high-trust — everyone owns their lane and executes without constant direction.



We are hiring an Operations Leader to own the back half of the business and systematically make it better. That means taking what currently runs on tribal knowledge, manual effort, and escalation habits — and replacing it with clean processes, documented SOPs, and automations that run without anyone having to think about them.



The Role

We are at a stage where the business needs to run with less involvement from the Leadership Team in day-to-day decisions, and the team needs to operate with less hand-holding. This role exists to fix both. You will inherit a capable but dependent team and a set of manual processes that should not be manual. Your job is to close both gaps — build the structure, build the automations, and build the team's ability to execute without constant intervention.



This is not a maintenance role. We are not looking for someone to manage the current state. We are looking for someone who sees a manual process and cannot leave it alone — someone who has done this before, brings a clear point of view on how operations at this scale should run, and has the technical skills to build it themselves.



What You'll Own

Before anything else, your job is to audit what we do manually and automate as much of it as possible. Every section below represents an area where there is room to build. We want someone who walks in, maps the current state, identifies the waste, and starts eliminating it. The task lists below are the starting point — not the ceiling.



Vendor Management & Fulfillment Tracking

Currently manual. We need automated.

Audit the full vendor communication workflow and identify every step that can be triggered automatically — delay alerts, claim follow-ups, shipment confirmations

Build automations in Zapier to route vendor-related triggers (tracking updates, delay thresholds, RMA status changes) into Slack and Zendesk without manual intervention

Own all vendor communication end-to-end: delays, damage claims, RMAs, missing parts, and cancellations — and systematically reduce the manual effort required to manage them

Conduct daily order tracking audits until automations make them unnecessary; log all outreach in order comments

Coordinate freight brokers for oversized, pallet, and freight-class shipments and returns

Build cooperative, long-term working relationships with all supplier contacts



Returns & Order Issues

Currently ad hoc. We need a system.

Map the entire returns process from first customer contact to vendor resolution and identify every manual touchpoint

Build automations to trigger RMA requests, update return status, and notify customers without someone manually chasing each step

Act as the escalation point for all returns, tracking issues, damage, and cancellations routed from the CS team

Determine return shipping responsibility — vendor error vs. customer remorse vs. outside return window — and document the decision framework so the team can apply it independently

Follow up with vendors within 1-2 business days on all open claims; maintain current status across all return records

Escalate to the Leadership Team only when outside policy, freight complexity, or vendor disputes require it



Customer Escalation Handling

Currently reactive. We need a playbook.

Build documented escalation playbooks so the CS team knows exactly how to handle difficult situations without escalating to you or leadership

Handle threatening customer situations personally — acknowledge professionally, de-escalate, log the full Zendesk thread

Escalate to the Leadership Team only when a customer threatens a dispute, bad review, BBB complaint, or legal action

Track escalation patterns and use them to identify training gaps or process failures upstream



CS Team Supervision & Training

Currently dependent. We need self-sufficient.

Supervise Philippines-based CS Reps; own their development, accountability, and day-to-day performance

Audit why escalations are happening — identify the root cause (unclear SOPs, missing training, no decision framework) and fix it at the source

Build the documentation and training structure that lets reps handle their lane without leaning on you or the Leadership Team

Train reps on workflow, escalation handling, and operational standards — then hold them to it

The goal: a team that handles its scope cleanly and escalates only what genuinely requires it



Reporting & Admin

Currently manual. We want it automated where possible.

Build automated reporting wherever possible — order status notifications, aged order alerts, fulfillment milestone triggers

Produce a weekly aged order summary with at-risk orders flagged for Leadership Team review until the process is automated

Maintain the COGS worksheet with weekly invoice data entry after orders ship; identify opportunities to automate data capture



Process Improvement — The Through-Line of Everything

This is not a separate workstream. It is the lens through which you approach every area above.

Use Zapier and Claude to build and maintain automations across fulfillment, returns, vendor communication, and customer-facing order status notifications

Write and own SOPs for every process in your area — document it well enough that someone new could execute it without asking questions

Build escalation frameworks that reduce the number of decisions requiring Leadership Team involvement

Bring a point of view — if you see something inefficient that is not in your lane, flag it

Track what you have built, what it replaced, and what the impact was



Must-Have Experience

Supervising and developing customer support teams in the Philippines

Building automations in Zapier that eliminated real manual work — you can point to specific examples

Overseeing e-commerce business operations end-to-end

Diagnosing team dependency issues and implementing the structure and accountability to resolve them

Tracking financials including COGS worksheets

Using AI tools (Claude or equivalent) to build workflows and drive process improvement

Working directly with external vendors — claims, RMAs, disputes, and relationship management

Making independent escalation decisions without defaulting upward to leadership

Filing and managing freight damage claims and coordinating returns logistics



Tech Stack — Required (Non-Negotiable)

Shopify

Zapier

Gmail

Slack

Google Sheets

Claude (Anthropic)



Nice to Have

Zendesk

HubSpot

QuickBooks

Calendly or equivalent scheduling tool

Experience with online freight brokers (Priority1 or similar)



What We're Looking For

The right person loves this kind of problem. They walk into an operation running on manual effort and tribal knowledge and see opportunity everywhere. They have done this before — taken a small, dependent team and built the structure that made them self-sufficient. They know how to write a process that people actually follow, how to build an automation that eliminates a recurring task, and how to hold people accountable without micromanaging them.



You do not wait to be told what is broken. You find it, fix it, and document it so it stays fixed. You bring prior experience and a clear point of view — not just a willingness to execute. If the idea of walking into an operation like this and putting your fingerprints all over it excites you, this role is for you.



To Apply

Read these instructions carefully — they are part of the application process.



Subject Line: Your application must include the following subject line exactly as written:



"Aqua Home Supply Operations Leader - Available to Start 6/22/26"



Applications submitted without this exact subject line will be immediately deleted, no exceptions.



Your submission must include all four of the following:



Your CV/resume.



A personalized video — record a short video (1-2 minutes) addressed specifically to Aqua Home Supply. Tell us who you are, what you know about our business, and why you believe you are the right fit for this role. Generic videos that could have been recorded for any company will not be considered. The video must mention Aqua Home Supply by name.



A written note — not a template, not a cover letter. A brief, specific paragraph describing an operational problem you personally identified and solved in a previous role. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the outcome?



Your interview availability — provide at least three specific time windows during the week of June 15-19, 2026. All times must be stated in Central Standard Time (CST).



Applications missing any of these four elements will be deleted without review. We are looking for someone who follows instructions precisely and executes with attention to detail — this process is the first test of exactly that.

title: Video Editor for Marketing Agency Required
description:
IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB POSTING DETAILS BEFORE APPLYING

PART-TIME Video Editor role (with the opportunity to move to full-time for the right candidate)



#What we are looking for#

Our high-priority tasks for this role include:



-Editing short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts): hooks, captions, b-roll, music, brand templates

-Editing long-form video (YouTube, client interviews, property walkthroughs)

-Repurposing long videos into multiple short clips

-Editing property videos, with an eye for how Irish homes and properties look

-Light ads and tech help: building and uploading ad creatives in Meta Ads Manager, and assisting inside GoHighLevel

-Confidently understanding spoken English instructions via videos and Zoom calls, and creating written SOPs

-Being adaptable and flexible in the tasks you complete within the agency



This job is for you if:

-You want to work in an environment where you are respected and treated fairly

-You pride yourself on being flexible and adaptable, and you are genuinely good with computers

-You cringe when you hear someone say something cannot be done

-You love learning new software and you find your own answers

-You welcome feedback and constructive criticism and look at them as an opportunity to get better

-You love staying organized and on top of your to-do list

-You want the freedom to take ownership of the role and to create your own best practices

-You enjoy finding solutions and love outside-of-the-box thinking

-You feel accomplished when your work is done to a high standard

-Most of all, a go-getter who wants an opportunity to grow into bigger roles as the agency grows



#First, let us talk about time expectations#

The hours can vary but you can expect 10 to 20 hours per week to start, growing for the right person. We work to Irish business hours (GMT), and you should be able to overlap for a daily check-in. From time to time we have tasks that need a quick turnaround, so some flexibility helps. This is a dynamic role with a daily check-in, not something scheduled far in advance.



#Now, let us talk about the awesome stuff#

-We have one policy. If you do the right thing by us, we will do the right thing by you.

-We are family first and we will do our absolute best to work around your needs. We understand that life can get in the way. ---All we ask is that you do not take advantage of this.

-We will always trust you until you give us a reason not to.

-You will never get in trouble or be reprimanded for an honest mistake, as long as you had our best interest at heart and thought it was the right decision.

-We actively encourage input. The worst case is a team of people too afraid to speak their piece.

-We are super transparent. If we are happy, you will know, and if we are not, you will know too.

-We are a fun, positive, growing team, and we love to support each other in our individual roles. We are like a virtual family.

-An opportunity to make a real difference. We are not churning and burning through clients, we want all of our team to be proud of where they work and the people they work for.

-We are big believers in hiring from the inside, so we actively encourage our team to look for opportunities to upskill.



#What you will be responsible for#

You will be the right-hand creative for our founder. Right now the agency is in a growth phase, and you will assist in producing the video and content that delivers results for clients.



Broad task 1: short-form video editing and repurposing

Broad task 2: long-form and property/listing video editing

Broad task 3: ad-creative production and Meta Ads Manager uploads

Broad task 4: GoHighLevel asset and funnel support, and writing simple SOPs



#Here is what we expect from you#

-As this is a remote position where we transfer large files back and forth, fast and reliable internet is a must.

-A capable computer, because editing is demanding.

-Nothing is ever a big enough problem that cannot be fixed if we are made aware of it. Disappearing when something goes wrong is a big no-no.

-You can understand and comprehend fluent spoken English, as all instructions and feedback are provided via Zoom and recorded video.

-You love getting things done. You keep your project board up to date and have high-touch communication, so we never have to track you down.

-You are a self-starter, problem-solver, and reliable. You can juggle lots of moving pieces and know how to focus and execute.

-You can bring ideas to the table and help drive the business forward.

-You love having full ownership over your work and constantly seek to improve it.

-You have high attention to detail and stay on brand, careful to avoid typos, without getting caught up in perfectionism.

-You are available and flexible Monday to Friday, with 10 to 20 hours per week to start.

-You are all about growth, and you can handle direct and blunt feedback for continuous improvement.

-You have a growth mindset and are open to participating in the online programs we provide.



#Application Details#

We will likely get 50+ applications for this role and we simply do not have time to interview that many, so make yours stand out if you want a role that can change the trajectory of your career.



This is a part-time job. Hours start at 10 to 20 per week and can grow as we scale. Compensation is USD $6 to $10 per hour depending on experience, with regular salary reviews.



This is a virtual role, so you can work from wherever is most comfortable. Be sure to tell us what rate you are looking for.

To prove you are detail-oriented and can follow a process, you must use the secret subject line for your application. It must include: I found my team



A short intro video is optional but will give you a big leg up. We are looking for personality over perfection. If you d
 not to send one, please tell us why.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a short follow-up message with a link to our application form, where you will upload your CV and a couple of quick screenshots.



Applications are due by [Friday, 19 June 2026], reviewed on a first come, first served basis.

description:

Join and actively monitor 4 private WhatsApp ticket groups (you will be added by us).

Tickets offered in the WhatsApp groups meaningfully below current market rates.

Emerging pricing trends or section-specific insights.

Deliver concise, actionable summary reports daily highlighting the top opportunities with rough margin estimates (factoring in platform fees and realistic transfer considerations).

Maintain strict confidentiality of all group activity and personal information.



Requirements

You must be very smart.

Strong attention to detail and excellent data hygiene (you enjoy turning messy chat messages into clean, usable spreadsheets).

Ability to set up automated Google App scripts to automatically ingest and organize the daily Whatapp chat exports and compare 

Advanced Google Sheets skills (filters, sorting, pivot tables, QUERY or basic formulas).

We value initiative with both the desire and ability to find a better way with process improvements.

Excellent written and spoke English

A dedicated, quiet workstation with dual monitors and highly reliable high-speed internet.

Pacific Time or North American time zone overlap.

Available to start within a few days



Nice to Have

Previous hands-on experience buying or selling tickets on StubHub, SeatGeek, or similar platforms, or working in a ticket brokerage/operations role.

Experience in  arbitrage.

Familiarity with anti-detection or multi-login browsers (Insomniac, Jancy, GoLogin, etc.) is a major asset.

Reliable WhatsApp user (WhatsApp Desktop experience is a plus for managing multiple groups).



Our Required Coverage Window (Vancouver Pacific Time - PST/PDT)

We need a team to cleanly cover the following weekly schedule. You do not need to work all of these hours alone, but you must be able to commit to fixed, dependable shift blocks within these windows:

Monday–Friday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Saturday & Sunday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM

A short note on why this role is a great fit

All relevant experience with ticket markets, arbitrage, data analysis, or WhatsApp/chat monitoring.

An example of how you would structure or have structured a tracking sheet for offers (or a link to a sample anonymized sheet if you have one).

Your expected hourly rate - note that we offer a performance bonus paid on each successful purchase from qualified opportunities found.

 Which exact Pacific Time hours you can work (example: “Mon-Fri 1pm–9pm + Sat-Sun 9am–6pm”)

Total hours per week you can work

title: People & Culture Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a People & Culture Coordinator who is dependable, proactive, organized, and genuinely cares about people.



This role is more than completing tasks or checking boxes. This person will help support the employee experience from the very beginning — from the first candidate conversation, to onboarding, to employee records, compliance follow-ups, and day-to-day People & Culture support.



We’re not just offering a job — we’re offering an opportunity to be part of something bigger.



The right person for this role will understand that People & Culture work matters because it directly impacts candidates, employees, managers, and the overall success of the organization. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates clearly, and wants to be part of a team that values people, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Our Core Values

Our work is guided by three core values:



People First

We care about people and how they experience our company. In this role, People First means communicating with respect, being responsive, helping candidates and employees feel supported, and showing patience and professionalism in every interaction.



Humble Excellence

We believe in doing the work well while staying open to learning and improvement. In this role, Humble Excellence means being reliable, detail-oriented, teachable, and committed to producing quality work even in a busy or changing environment.



Genuine Integrity

We believe in doing the right thing, even when no one is watching. In this role, Genuine Integrity means protecting confidential information, documenting accurately, following through on commitments, and communicating honestly and professionally.



Work Schedule

Availability within 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST, with flexibility depending on recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, and operational needs.



Compensation

$700 per month (Introductory)



Responsibilities

What You Will Be Doing

As the People & Culture Coordinator, you will help keep important HR processes organized, moving, and properly followed through.



Your responsibilities will include but not limited to:



Recruitment & Candidate Coordination

Supporting recruitment for Florida regions. This includes job postings, candidate communication, interview scheduling, phone screenings, reference checks, employment verifications, and helping maintain a strong candidate pipeline.

Onboarding & New Hire Experience

Preparing and initiating onboarding, supporting new hire orientation with the People & Culture Manager, and helping ensure new hires are welcomed, informed, and prepared for their role.

Employee Records & Compliance Support

Maintaining accurate employee records in ClayHR, supporting weekly license audits, following up on pending or expired items, and helping keep employee files and documentation organized.

Employee Relations & Documentation Support

Assisting with employee relations matters in partnership with the People & Culture Manager, including documentation support, Employee Accountability forms, Employee Assessments, and appropriate follow-up.

People & Culture Operations Support

Supporting reports, trackers, audits, applicant inquiries, Operations meeting follow-ups, and other People & Culture projects that help keep the department organized and moving forward.

Continuous Growth & Development

Participating in monthly professional development and remaining open to learning, feedback, and process improvement.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a dependable, organized, and values-driven individual who can support People & Culture responsibilities with professionalism, care, and consistency.



The ideal candidate is someone who demonstrates strong follow-through, clear communication, attention to detail, and good judgment. This person should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, handling confidential information, and supporting both candidates and employees with respect and professionalism.



This role requires someone who can work independently while staying aligned with leadership, ask questions when clarity is needed, and remain calm and solution-focused when priorities shift.



We are looking for someone who is open to feedback, committed to growth, and understands that People & Culture work requires both structure and heart.



Who Will Succeed in This Role

You will succeed in this role if you are someone who takes pride in being dependable, organized, and helpful.



This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys supporting people, keeping processes on track, and contributing to a positive and professional employee experience.



The right person will bring initiative, clear communication, follow-through, and a willingness to learn while supporting the ongoing needs of the People & Culture team.



Qualifications

At least 3 years of related HR, recruitment, administrative, or coordinator experience preferred.

Experience with recruitment, onboarding, employee records, or HR support is strongly preferred.

Familiarity with HRIS, applicant tracking systems, or employee recordkeeping systems is a plus.

Strong Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or related software skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision after training.

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field is preferred, but not required if the candidate has strong relevant experience.

A Note to Applicants

This role is for someone who wants to grow in People & Culture and understands that HR work requires both care for people and strong attention to detail.



You will support recruitment, onboarding, employee records, compliance follow-up, employee relations support, and coordination with Operations. Because of this, we need someone dependable, organized, confidential, and consistent with follow-through.



You do not need to know everything on day one, but you must be willing to learn, ask questions, communicate updates, and take ownership of your work.



If you are people-centered, detail-oriented, responsive, and aligned with our values of People First, Humble Excellence, and Genuine Integrity, we would be happy to hear from you.

Alongside driving this AI initiative, you will take charge of structuring, developing, and maintaining complex custom WordPress websites from start to finish.



Your Responsibilities:

- Experience: 5+ years of professional experience, with a solid understanding of performance optimization and SEO best practices.

What You’ll Get:

- The chance to pioneer AI integration within our company and work on technically challenging projects.

- A salary between $500 and $1000, depending on your experience and abilities. (Note: as discussed, higher compensation is available for successfully leading the AI integration).

If you’re enthusiastic about merging AI with traditional development, structuring complex platforms, and taking ownership of your work, we’re excited to see your portfolio. To show you’ve read this job posting, please reply with the word “banana.”



Let’s build something great together!

title: Google Adwords Expert
description:
I need a Google Ads EXPERT to run split tests and experiments 

on a sandbox Google Ads account I'll create for this role.



Important context: I run my own main Google Ads account 

profitably and have for years. I have 25 years of direct 

marketing experience. I am not hiring you to run my main 

account or teach me Google Ads. I'm hiring you to test things 

I haven't tested, find angles I haven't seen, and bring me 

data-backed recommendations.



The structure:

- You get full access to a SEPARATE Google Ads account I'll 

  create

- That account points to a secondary landing page or microsite, 

  not my main funnel

- You run experiments there: ad copy variations, audience tests, 

  landing page splits, bidding strategy experiments, campaign 

  type comparisons

- You document what works and what doesn't, monthly

- I implement winning strategies on my main account myself

- After 60-90 days of proven results, we may discuss read-only 

  access to my main account so you can analyze actual data and 

  propose better experiments



If "I'll just run your real account" is what you wanted, this 

isn't the role. The sandbox structure is intentional.



What I'm NOT hiring:

- A Google Ads "VA" who needs to be told what to do

- Someone who only knows e-commerce ROAS playbooks

- A generalist who runs multiple ad platforms but specializes 

  in none

- Anyone whose first move is "let's launch Performance Max" 

  without thinking



Pay: $15-25/hour, depending on experience. If you're truly 

senior and command more, tell me and make your case.



QUESTIONS — answer all 7 honestly. Specifics over generalities.



1. Tell me about the Google Ads accounts you currently work on. 

   How many, what industries, monthly ad spend ranges, and how 

   long with each? (Don't name the clients — describe them.)



2. What's the longest-running Google Ads relationship you've 

   had with a single client? Why is it still going (or why did 

   it end)?



3. Describe a time a Google Ads experiment you ran failed badly. 

   What was the hypothesis, what happened, what did you do, 

   and what did you learn?



4. Describe a time a client wanted you to do something in 

   Google Ads that you thought was a bad idea. What did you 

   do? What was the outcome?



5. Send me a Loom video walking through ONE of your current 

   or recent Google Ads accounts. Show me the campaign 

   structure, ad groups, conversion data, audience setup, 

   negatives, and bidding strategy. 5-10 minutes max. Blur 

   client info if needed.



   If you can't or won't send a Loom, you're not the expert 

   I'm looking for. Real Google Ads operators record Looms 

   constantly.



6. What's something you've learned about Google Ads in the 

   last 3 months that changed how you work? Where did you 

   learn it?



7. Tell me your rate structure preferences:

   - Hourly rate

   - Monthly retainer for ongoing management (typical hours/month)

   - One-time audit pricing

   

   Tell me which you prefer for this role and why.



TO APPLY:



- Use a multiple of 7 Apply Points (7, 14, 21, 28, etc.). 

  7 is enough if your answers are specific and your Loom is

title: YouTube Prompt Engineer & Script Quality Controller (AI Biblical History Network)
description:
Channel Niche Notice: We run a high-volume media network deeply rooted in Biblical history, archaeology, and ancient Near Eastern narratives, with active plans to expand into broader historical eras (the Middle Ages, Roman history, etc.). A strong familiarity with, or a deep interest in, Biblical texts, theology, and ancient historical analysis is highly advantageous for this role.



Job Description:

PLEASE READ THIS FIRST: We are NOT looking for a traditional creative scriptwriter. We do not want someone to sit down at a blank page and type essays from scratch. That slows down our pipeline.



Instead, we are looking for a highly analytical Prompt Engineer & Script Quality Controller to oversee our automated historical media pipeline.



Our Content Factory utilizes advanced AI systems to handle high-volume script generation and deep historical research extraction. Your core mission is two-fold:



Front-End Engineering: You will actively develop, test, and write advanced system and API prompts to ensure our AI engines output structurally elite first drafts.



Back-End Quality Control: Once the scripts are generated by your prompts, you will act as the human firewall—checking, refining, and verifying the final text to ensure it strictly meets our high narrative and accuracy standards before going to production.



Please note: To prove you are reading carefully, you must include the word ANCIENT as the final word of your application message.



Key Responsibilities:



Prompt Optimization: Write and iterate complex system/API prompts (using frameworks like Claude and OpenAI) to force the AI to natively output specific audience retention mechanics (psychological open loops, micro-hooks every 45 seconds, cliffhangers, and perfect narrative pacing).



Output Quality Control: Methodically audit the AI-generated script outputs. If the AI text drops in quality, you fix the text manually for production, and then immediately re-engineer the system prompts so the machine doesn't make the same mistake twice.



Accuracy Verification: Ensure that the engineered prompts extract and maintain profound historical and archaeological accuracy without losing narrative tension.



Data-Driven Iteration: Cross-reference YouTube Studio retention graphs with our script templates to identify where viewers get bored, and systematically update the prompt logic to fix those specific algorithmic leaks.



Requirements:



Proven experience writing advanced, structured prompts for LLMs/AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, or APIs) to output specific formatting and behavioral constraints.



Exceptional analytical editing skills. You look at a script like a machine and know exactly when a paragraph will cause a viewer to click away.



Solid understanding of YouTube analytics (specifically AVD, retention charts, and viewer drop-off psychology).



Flawless written English and an eagle eye for pacing, conversational flow, and structural narrative tension.



Rate, Type & Career Growth:



Immediate Start: This begins as a project-based paid trial, estimated at 15–20 hours per week to evaluate your prompt mechanics and structural script approach.



Long-Term Trajectory: While this is a part-time gig at the very start, we are looking for a long-term strategic partner. If your prompt engineering and quality checks successfully move our target tracking metrics, this will transition into a permanent, consistent part-time or full-time strategic role as we scale our network.



Compensation: $10.00 – $15.00 USD/hour (negotiable based on your proven track record with YouTube retention analytics and prompt engineering).



How to Apply (Strict Instructions — Failure to follow means instant rejection):



To apply, you must strictly follow these 3 steps:



Start the very first line of your cover letter with the word "STRATEGY".



Provide a link to a short 60-second audio or video recording (using free tools like 
 or 
) introducing yourself and mentioning one history channel whose pacing you admire.



Answer this specific diagnostic question: If a long-form video starts with a healthy 70% retention in the first 30 seconds, but suddenly drops sharply by 30?tween the 1-minute and 2-minute mark, what did the script structurally fail to do, and what specific instruction would you add to the AI prompt to prevent this from happening?

title: Youtube Lifestyle Video Editor
description:
YouTube Video Editor (Lifestyle / Travel Vlogs)



Position: YouTube Video Editor  

Employment Type: Long-Term Contract Position  

Compensation: Competitive Pay (Based on Experience & Portfolio)  

Location: Remote



### About the Role

We're looking for a talented YouTube video editor to join our team and help create high-retention lifestyle and travel vlogs. This is not a basic editing position. We need someone who understands storytelling, audience psychology, pacing, and how to keep viewers engaged from beginning to end.



The editing style we're aiming for is similar to creators such as Brez Scales and BSM Fredo. The goal is to make viewers feel like they're experiencing the journey with us, not just watching random clips stitched together.



If you know how to turn raw footage into content people cannot stop watching, we want to hear from you.



### Responsibilities

- Create engaging, high-retention YouTube vlogs from raw footage.

- Develop strong storytelling intros that immediately capture attention within the first 5 to 30 seconds.

- Identify and preserve every exciting, funny, emotional, luxurious, or high-energy 
nt.

- Remove dead space, repetitive footage, awkward pauses, and anything that hurts viewer retention.

- Structure videos to maintain curiosity and 
ntum throughout the entire vlog.

- Use purposeful cuts, zooms, punch-ins, sound design, and pacing techniques to increase engagement.

- Incorporate B-roll, overlays, graphics, and cinematic sequences when appropriate.

- Add transitions that enhance storytelling without becoming distracting or overused.

- Color correct and color grade footage to improve overall image quality.

- Improve poorly lit scenes whenever possible through professional editing techniques.

- Sync edits with music to elevate emotional 
nts and create energy.

- Utilize music from our approved playlists while ensuring copyright compliance.

- Balance dialogue, music, ambient sounds, and sound effects for a polished final product.

- Maintain consistency with our brand style across all videos.

- Organize project files and deliver edits in a timely manner.

- Be receptive to feedback and implement revisions efficiently.



### Requirements

- Experience editing YouTube lifestyle, entrepreneurship, luxury lifestyle, or travel content.

- Proven experience working with U.S.-based creators or brands.

- Strong understanding of YouTube audience retention principles.

- Ability to build compelling narratives from large amounts of footage.

- Excellent sense of timing, pacing, and comedic delivery.

- Skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.

- Strong color correction and audio editing abilities.

- Experience sourcing and incorporating B-roll effectively.

- Ability to follow brand guidelines while also bringing creative ideas to the table.

- Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines consistently.

- Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.

- Attention to detail and a commitment to excellence.



### Bonus Qualifications

- Experience editing videos in styles similar to Brez Scales, BSM Fredo, MrBeast, Airrack, or other high-retention creators.

- Ability to create custom motion graphics.

- Understanding of YouTube analytics and how editing impacts watch time.

- Experience creating compelling thumbnails or providing thumbnail recommendations.

- Knowledge of current YouTube trends and viewer behavior.

- Ability to suggest improvements to filming techniques that would improve the editing process.



### What Success Looks Like

- Viewers stay engaged throughout the vlog.

- The videos feel cinematic, entertaining, and authentic.

- Exciting 
nts are amplified, while slower 
nts still contribute to the story.

- Videos consistently improve in pacing, retention, and overall quality.

- Our audience feels invested in the lifestyle, experiences, and journey being documented.



### To Apply

Please submit:



1. Your portfolio or YouTube videos you have edited.

2. Examples of lifestyle or travel vlogs you've worked on.

3. The software you use for editing. ( prefer premiere pro , final cut pro , davinci resolve , after effects )

4. Your typical turnaround time for a 15 to 30-minute vlog.

5. Your desired compensation.

6. A brief explanation of how you approach editing for viewer retention.



Important: Applications without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Data VA — Commercial Property Research / Long-Term Role
description:
**Job Title:** Real Estate Data VA — Commercial Property Research / Long-Term Role



**Job Type:** Full Time or Part Time after 1 week paid trial

**Hours:** 30 - 40 hours/week

**Starting Pay:** $4/hour for a 1-week paid trial

**Long-Term Pay:** Open to much higher pay for the right person

**Bonuses:** Available based on accuracy, ownership, speed, and results

**Hours:** Flexible - Preferred hours in between 6a & 10p EST until trained

**Industry:** Commercial Real Estate / Mobile Home Parks



---



### About the Role



I am looking for a serious Data VA to help build accurate commercial real estate lead lists.



The work will start mainly with **mobile home parks**, but over time it may include other commercial property types.



This is not just basic copy/paste work.



You will help research properties, owners, companies, buyers, sellers, addresses, websites, phone numbers, and other data points. You will help organize the data so it can move into the correct workflow.



The goal is to build high-quality “sniper leads” — not random lists.



---



### What You Will Do



You will help with tasks like:



* Researching mobile home parks and commercial properties

* Finding owner information

* Checking LLCs, mailing addresses, websites, and company details

* Organizing data inside Google Sheets

* Separating seller leads from buyer leads

* Keeping data clean, accurate, and easy to understand

* Following a step-by-step process

* Noticing mistakes or gaps before I have to point them out

* Suggesting improvements when you see a better way



Experience in real estate is helpful, but not required.



What matters more is that you are accurate, fast, honest, organized, and willing to learn.



---



### Who I’m Looking For



I am looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not just another task.



You should be:



* Very accurate with data

* Fast but not careless

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking smart questions

* Comfortable giving updates without me chasing you

* Confident on calls or voice messages

* Honest when something is unclear

* Interested in improving the process

* Someone who wants to grow financially and professionally



I do not need someone perfect.



But I do need someone who takes ownership.



I do not want someone who only clocks in, waits for instructions, and does the bare minimum.



---



### Communication Style



I am easy to work with, but I move seriously.



I do not want to manage every small detail every day.



I will train you and help you understand the process, but I need someone who thinks, pays attention, and cares about the result.



Accent does not matter.



Confidence, honesty, and clear communication matter.



---



### Important



I have hired many VAs before.



Most were okay at doing simple tasks, but I am looking for someone different for this role.



I want someone who can become excellent at the data process and possibly help train future tea
mbers as we grow.



If the company grows and you help create that growth, I want you to grow with it too.



---



### Trial Process



Before being hired long term, you will need to complete a small data test so I can see your accuracy and how you think.



If the test looks good, we will start with a **1-week paid trial at $4/hour, 30 hours paid on the 7th day via GCash Google Currency Exchange Rate**.



After the paid trial, if the fit is strong, I am open to increasing your hourly pay quickly.



I am not looking for the cheapest person. I am looking for the right person.



If you are excellent, accurate, fast, organized, and take ownership, there is room for higher pay, bonuses, and long-term growth.



---



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short message explaining why this role fits you

2. Your previous experience with research, data, Google Sheets, or real estate

3. Your internet speed and computer setup

4. A short voice recording introducing yourself

5. Show me you have a working US VPN by sending a short screen recording of you being able to access 
 (If it asks you to pay or doesn't let you search a name that means you do not have a VPN and cannot apply to this position.)

6. Your answer to this question:

   **What makes you different from most VAs?**



Use this subject line:



**Commercial Data VA — I Pay Attention**

title: Assistant Real Estate Syndication
description:
Real Estate Acquisition Analyst (Multifamily)



**Position**: Real Estate Acquisition Analyst  

**Reports to**: CEO  

**Job Type**: Full-time  



Overview:

We are seeking a highly motivated and dynamic Real Estate Acquisition Analyst with a background in finance and a strong interest in multifamily real estate investments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and presenting potential multifamily investment opportunities to the CEO. This role requires someone with an outgoing personality, capable of building strong relationships with brokers, property managers, and insurance providers.



Key Responsibilities:



1. **Deal Sourcing & Relationship Building**:

   - Proactively reach out to brokers to source multifamily deals.

   - Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers to gain early access to potential deals.

   - Conduct follow-up calls with brokers to clarify details on deals and obtain necessary information.



2. **Financial Analysis**:

   - Review and analyze Offering Memorandums (OMs) provided by brokers.

   - Input deal details into a syndication analyzer tool to assess the financial viability of potential investments.

   - Conduct financial modeling and sensitivity analysis to evaluate various investment scenarios.

   - **Analyze at least four multifamily deals per week**, ensuring a consistent pipeline of investment opportunities.



3. **Property Due Diligence**:

   - Collaborate with local property managers to verify and validate financial assumptions (e.g., rent projections, vacancy rates, maintenance costs).

   - Contact insurance brokers to obtain accurate insurance quotes for properties under consideration.



4. **Investment Presentation**:

   - Prepare and present detailed investment reports and deal packages to the CEO for review.

   - Highlight key deal metrics, potential risks, and value-add opportunities for each deal.

   - Provide recommendations on which deals align with the company’s investment strategy.



5. **Market Research & Value-Add Identification**:

   - Conduct research on local markets to identify emerging trends, rent growth potential, and other market factors that could impact the deal’s success.

   - Identify and analyze value-add opportunities within potential acquisitions, such as renovations, operational improvements, and market repositioning.



6. **Cross-Functional Coordination**:

   - Work closely with internal teams, including finance, operations, and legal, to ensure a smooth transaction process from start to finish.

   - Coordinate with external vendors, including property managers, insurance brokers, and other third-party service providers, to gather and verify essential deal information.



#### Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Business, or a related field.

- 2+ years of experience in real estate acquisitions, finance, or related fields.

- Strong financial modeling skills, with proficiency in using syndication analyzer tools and Excel.

- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with brokers, property managers, and other real estate professionals.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a confident and outgoing personality.

- Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and the ability to identify key value-add opportunities.

- Familiarity with real estate market trends and an understanding of the multifamily investment landscape.



#### Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience working with multifamily real estate transactions, including syndication deals.

- Knowledge of local real estate markets and regulatory environments.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.



#### Compensation:

[Insert Salary/Compensation Package Information]



#### Application Instructions:

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their experience in real estate acquisitions and financial analysis.



--- 

This version includes the added requirement for analyzing at least four deals per week, ensuring a steady flow of opportunities for the company.

title: Video Editor  —  Short Form for a Female Creator Brand
description:
Video Editor — Short-Form for a Female Creator Brand 



We're hiring a Video Editor to become the right hand of our in-house female creator — someone who turns raw clips into content women actually stop scrolling to watch.



This is not a "cut the clips and ship it" job. We're building a content machine, and we want an editor who's genuinely fired up to grow with us, gets better with every edit, and wants this to be a real home — not a one-month gig.



This role supports:

•	Short-form vertical content (primary)

•	Affiliate marketing & brand-driven content



If you love making content that helps women feel motivated, disciplined, confident, and capable — you're going to love it here.

________________________________________



The Game We're Playing 

We sell products by making content people genuinely want to watch, especially on TikTok Shop. Some of it runs organically as shoppable content; some of it runs as paid ads. Either way, good editing is what makes someone stop, watch, and buy.



It's a volume game. The more strong content we put out, the more we grow — and when we grow, everyone who helped build it grows too. Your edits don't disappear into a void. Think of every post as a seed: plant enough good ones and they turn into real revenue — for the brand, for the company, and for you.



That's the whole point. We win as a team, and we want a teammate who's hungry to win.

________________________________________

What We're Really Looking For (Read This Part Twice) 

Skills can be taught. Drive can't. Before anything else, we want someone who:

•	Is genuinely fired up to make great content — not just clock hours

•	Believes they can produce high-quality work. And if you're not fully there yet — that's okay. We will train you. But you have to want it.

•	Is coachable — takes feedback without ego and applies it to the very next edit

•	Is ready to commit. We pour real time, training, and trust into our editors. So we're looking for someone who will commit back and build something long-term with us — not someone passing through.

________________________________________



What You'll Do 

•	Edit short-form videos in our brand style

•	Turn organized B-roll plans and raw footage into scroll-stopping cuts

•	Organizing files in Google Drive using our folder and naming structure

•	Collaborate in 
 for feedback, revisions, and approvals

•	Keep your project status updated in Airtable as you work

•	Learn our niche and audience — who they are and how they watch

•	Follow our documented workflows and creative standards

•	Apply feedback and get sharper with every single edit



________________________________________



Who We're Looking For 

Required

•	Female editor (to match our brand and audience)

•	Short-form social editing experience

•	Strong storytelling instincts

•	Organized and detail-oriented

•	Reliable communication and availability

•	Comfortable working inside a structured, documented system

•	Fired up, coachable, and ready to commit (see the section above — this matters most)

Huge Plus

•	Experience editing for female creators

•	Familiar with wellness, fitness, or lifestyle niches

•	Experience with affiliate or UGC-style content

•	You genuinely enjoy systems, clarity, and repeatable workflows



________________________________________



Compensation 

We pay hourly, and we keep it simple and fair.

How it works

•	You're paid for the hours you work. Tell us your preferred hourly rate when you apply.

•	Prefer a salary? Once you've proven out, we offer salaried arrangements — and the deal is straightforward: commit to your hours, consistently show up, and we pay your full contracted amount, even on a week you come up a little short. (If hours drop far below what we agreed, pay reflects the hours actually worked. Hit your commitment and you never have to think about it.)

Bonuses & extras

•	We regularly add bonuses and extra pay onto paychecks for strong work. When you make us look good, we take care of you.

•	We run team challenges and incentives — like "we need 100 assets this week, let's go" — with rewards for the crew that delivers. Fast, motivated editors earn more here, not just more hours.

You only ever get paid for real work — and strong, committed editors consistently earn above their base.

Learning & Growth — We Invest In You 

You do not need to be a branded-UGC master on day one. If you're coachable and hungry, we will get you there.

We give you:

•	Real examples of the content we want you to make

•	Creators in our niche we admire, for inspiration

•	Visual references for pacing, captions, and style

•	A clear brief for every single asset

In return, we ask for commitment. The training, the feedback, the systems — that's us investing in you. We're looking for an editor who will take that investment and build a long-term home here.

Growth is expected. Perfection on day one is not.



________________________________________



How We Work (And Why People Stay) 

•	Work on your own time. We care about output and deadlines, not whether you're online 9-to-5. Start with the hours that fit your life and ramp up as you prove out and want more — part-time is a perfectly fine place to begin.

•	A real community. Our team lives in 
 — it's friendly, supportive, and genuinely fun. You're not editing alone in the dark; you've got a crew.

•	Clarity over chaos. Documented workflows, organized files, clear expectations. You're never guessing what to do next.

•	A system that has your back. For B-roll content, our system drafts a plan for each video — the building blocks come organized and ready, so you're never staring at a blank timeline wondering where to start. You get to focus on the craft.

Tools You'll Use (We Teach You — No Stress If You're New) 

•	Google Drive — organized project folders

•	
 — feedback, revisions, approvals

•	Airtable — a friendly editor dashboard where you track your work and pull each video's plan

Every workflow is documented, intuitive, and built to be easy to follow. Never touched these before? We'll teach you.

description:
Job Description:



We are seeking an experienced and technically capable Paraplanner to join our growing advisory practice. This is a key support role working closely with our Financial Advisers to deliver high-quality, compliant financial advice and exceptional client outcomes.

The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years’ experience in a financial planning or wealth management environment and possess strong technical capability across SOA preparation, SMSFs, retirement modelling, ROAs, and annual review processes.

This role is best suited to someone who is highly organised, technically proficient, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing advice implementation, client servicing, and general workflow support in a fast-paced advice environment.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Financial Planning & Advice Support (Primary Focus)

- Prepare high-quality Statements of Advice (SOAs) and Records of Advice (ROAs) across a broad range of financial strategies.

- Conduct detailed client data gathering and analysis, including:

Cash flow and budgeting

Account rundowns

Superannuation and retirement planning

Investment portfolios

Personal insurance

Asset and liability positions

- Assist Advisers with retirement modelling, scenario analysis, and strategy forecasting to support client objectives.

- Support and prepare advice relating to Self-Managed Super Funds (SMSFs) and broader superannuation strategies.

- Prepare client meeting documentation, including Fact Finds, risk profiles, portfolio reports, strategy modelling, and review packs.

- Manage advice implementation, including liaising with product providers and ensuring all documentation is completed accurately and efficiently.

- Support and coordinate Annual Review processes, including preparation of review documentation and implementation of ongoing advice strategies.

- Utilise financial planning software (including Xplan and Worksorted, highly regarded) to maintain accurate client records, model strategies, and generate advice documentation.



2. Administration & Workflow Support

- Assist with general administration tasks and daily workflow management across the practice as required.

- Support the team with ad hoc operational tasks to ensure smooth and efficient client service delivery.

- Maintain accurate and timely updates within the CRM system, including file notes, correspondence, and task management.



3. Compliance & Administration

- Ensure all advice documentation and processes comply with AFS licence obligations, Best Interests Duty (BID), and regulatory requirements.

- Maintain accurate and detailed client records, file notes, and correspondence within the CRM system.

- Support ongoing compliance, audit, and annual review obligations of the practice.

- Assist in improving advice workflows and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency.



Qualifications

1. 3–5 years’ experience within a paraplanning role.

2. Demonstrated experience preparing SOAs, ROAs, and Annual Reviews.

3. Strong understanding of superannuation, retirement planning, and SMSF strategies.

4. XTOOLS+, wealthsolver and risk researcher competency.

5. Experience with retirement modelling and strategy analysis.

6. High proficiency with advice software, particularly Xplan (Worksorted highly regarded) and the Microsoft Office Suite.

7. Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

8. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex concepts clearly.

title: Owner Operator Dispatch Coordinator
description:
Gomez Haulers (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a growing asset-based trucking operation and owner-operator program focused on keeping freight moving safely, efficiently, and profitably. We support independent owner-operators running under the Gomez Haulers MC through dedicated contract freight, strategic dispatching, compliance oversight, and operational support.



This is not a call center position. This is a real trucking operations role where you will work directly with drivers, dispatchers, and operations leadership to ensure loads move successfully from assignment to delivery while maintaining compliance, documentation accuracy, and strong driver support.



Role Overview

You will serve as the primary operational point of contact for a group of owner-operators operating under the Gomez Haulers network. You will manage route assignments, driver communication, documentation, compliance tracking, load monitoring, and settlement coordination while ensuring every driver has the support needed to operate successfully.



This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced transportation operations, communicates effectively with drivers, stays organized under pressure, and takes ownership of problems before they become operational disruptions



What You’ll Be Doing



Dispatch & Load Management

• Assign dedicated routes and scheduled loads based on driver availability, location, and equipment.

• Manage daily route boards and confirm driver assignments, departure times, and delivery schedules.

• Coordinate return loads, backhauls, and spot market opportunities when applicable.

• Monitor active loads in real time through tracking platforms and GPS visibility tools.

• Communicate route changes, delays, weather impacts, and operational updates to drivers promptly.

• Ensure all assigned loads have confirmed driver, trailer, and departure information before dispatch.



Driver Communication & Support

• Serve as the primary point of contact for owner-operators throughout their workday.

• Maintain consistent communication through phone, messaging platforms, and operational systems.

• Conduct daily check-ins with active drivers to confirm schedules, progress, and operational concerns.

• Coordinate with facilities, customers, and internal departments to resolve issues impacting deliveries.

• Escalate a
, breakdowns, service failures, delays, and compliance concerns immediately.



Documentation & Administrative Oversight

• Review and process Bills of Lading (BOLs), Proofs of Delivery (PODs), rate confirmations, and supporting documentation.

• Ensure delivery documents are uploaded accurately and within required deadlines.

• Maintain driver qualification records, insurance documentation, and compliance files.

• Track fuel receipts, toll records, scale tickets, and other required operational paperwork.

• Prepare and submit weekly settlement and operational reports.



Compliance & Safety Monitoring

• Monitor driver Hours of Service (HOS) and ELD activity.

• Identify and address potential compliance violations before they occur.

• Track expiration dates for medical cards, licenses, inspections, drug testing requirements, and qualification files.

• Coordinate annual inspections and required compliance documentation.

• Report safety i
 and compliance concerns to leadership immediately.



Billing & Settlement Support

• Coordinate with billing teams to ensure completed loads are invoiced accurately and on time.

• Verify settlement deductions, advances, fuel charges, and related driver expenses.

• Reconcile completed loads against settlement records and identify discrepancies.

• Assist drivers with settlement questions and escalate complex issues when necessary.



Operational Excellence

• Maintain accurate information across company systems and operational platforms.

• Identify recurring operational issues and recommend process improvements.

• Provide daily and weekly operational updates to management.

• Take ownership of assigned drivers and loads from dispatch through completion.



Who We’re Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in trucking dispatch, freight brokerage, logistics coordination, or transportation operations.

• Strong understanding of trucking terminology including BOLs, PODs, ELDs, HOS, DOT, MC numbers, and rate confirmations.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

title: Content & Creative Specialist — Luxury Vacation Rental Brand | Reels, Ads, Email & PR
description:
We’re Penrose Collective, a luxury hospitality company managing a portfolio of stunning short-term rental properties across the US — including a 7-bedroom estate and micro-wedding venue in Texas, a boutique cabin in the Catskills (NY), and more properties launching soon. We attract guests through direct bookings, Airbnb, and Google — and we need one creative person who can own ALL our visual content, from viral Reels to
 flyers to paid ad creatives.



This is not just a video editing role. You’ll be our one-person creative studio.



What You’ll Be Doing



Video Content (~60% of your time)

• Receiving raw video footage of our properties (interiors, exteriors, weddings, guest experiences, drone shots, behind-the-scenes) via Google Drive

• Independently researching trending formats, hooks, audio, and editing styles across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Editing and producing 2–3 short-form videos per day (30–90 seconds each) — property tours, wedding content, before/afters, seasonal edits, POV walkthroughs, trend adaptations

• Using AI tools (CapCut AI, Runway, Opus Clip, ElevenLabs, Pika, etc.) to enhance quality and speed

• Writing scroll-stopping hooks, captions, and CTAs for each video

• Adapting each edit for cross-platform posting (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Pinterest)



 Flyers & Marketing Collateral (~20% of your time)

• Designing
 flyers and newsletters for leads who come in through our website — these need to look premium, on-brand, and drive bookings

• Creating seasonal promo
s (holiday weekends, wedding season, retreat packages)

• Building
 templates in Canva that we can reuse and customize for different properties and offers

• Maintaining consistent brand aesthetic across all
 touchpoints (our brand palette is warm, luxury, earthy — think Poppy Orange tones, clean fonts, editorial feel)



Ad Creatives & Graphic Design (~15% of your time)

• Designing static and carousel ad creatives for Google Ads,
/Instagram Ads, and Pinterest Ads

• Creating social media graphics — Instagram carousels, Stories, Pinterest pins,
 event covers

• Building Canva templates for recurring content types (testimonials, pricing highlights, property features, FAQ graphics)

• Writing short ad copy and headlines for paid campaigns — punchy, benefit-driven, conversion-focused

• Designing one-pagers, lookbooks, or PDF guides when needed (e.g., “Your Wedding Weekend at Penrose House” guide for leads)



PR & Brand Presence (~5% of your time)

• Researching and compiling media opportunities — travel blogs, wedding publications, lifestyle press, and STR/hospitality industry features that are a fit for our properties

• Drafting outreach
s to journalists, bloggers, and editors pitching Penrose Collective stories (property launches, unique guest experiences, design features, wedding offerings)

• Monitoring brand mentions across Google, social media, and review platforms and flagging anything worth responding to or amplifying

• Sourcing and coordinating gifted stay or press trip opportunities with travel influencers and content creators

• Maintaining a running PR tracker (target outlets, contact info, pitch status, follow-up dates)

• Supporting award or editorial submission opportunities (e.g., “Best Wedding Venues in Texas,” travel listicles, hospitality features)



What We’re Looking For



Must-Haves:

• 1+ year of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Strong proficiency in CapCut Pro (required) — Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is a bonus

• Advanced Canva skills — you can design polished flyers,
 layouts, ad creatives, and social graphics quickly

• Deep understanding of what makes short-form content go viral — hooks, pacing, retention, trending audio

• Ability to write clean, persuasive ad copy and
 copy in English — not just edit visuals

• Eye for luxury/premium brand aesthetics — your designs should feel high-end, not templated

• Basic color grading and audio mixing skills for video

• Reliable internet and a machine that handles 1080p/4K footage

• Available 40 hours/week, Philippine time (flexible on exact hours)

• Self-starter who pitches ideas, not someone who waits to be told what to do



Strong Bonuses:

• Experience with AI tools (Runway, Pika, HeyGen, Opus Clip, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT for copy)

• Background creating content for hospitality, travel, wedding, real estate, or lifestyle brands

• Experience with
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Flodesk, or similar)

• Understanding of Google Ads / Meta Ads creative best practices

• Experience designing PDF lookbooks, pricing guides, or event packages

• Familiarity with Pinterest content strategy

• Experience growing a brand’s social following organically

• Prior PR, media outreach, or influencer coordination experience — even informal (running your own blog, pitching brands, managing collab partnerships)



How to Apply

To be considered, please send the following:



	1.	A short intro about yourself and why this role is a fit

	2.	2–3 video edits you’ve done (links preferred — Google Drive, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

Applications without samples will not be reviewed. We move fast — if it’s a fit, you’ll hear from us within a few days.

initiatives.

title: UK E-Commerce Accountant & Bookkeeper Needed – Xero & Shopify Ecom Expert (Backlog + Monthly Retainer)
description:
Job Description:

We are a fast-growing, UK-based e-commerce brand selling physical products via Shopify. We are seeking a highly skilled, meticulous financial professional who can handle our daily/weekly bookkeeping and provide high-level strategic UK tax guidance.



Requirements: You MUST have deep, proven experience with UK tax laws, HMRC guidelines, and legitimate corporate tax avoidance strategies. A university degree in Accountancy or Finance is highly preferred, but significant, verifiable experience managing accounts specifically for Shopify e-commerce businesses is mandatory. You must be willing to hop on a live voice/video call with the founder to discuss strategy.



Current Scope of Work:

Phase 1: The Backlog Clean-Up (Immediate)

We currently have a historical backlog of un-reconciled transactions that need to be completely cleaned up, accurately categorized, and balanced in Xero.



Budget: $400 USD (Fixed one-time fee) to get the historical accounts perfectly up to date.



Phase 2: Ongoing Maintenance Retainer

Once the backlog is fully cleared, this will transition into a stable, long-term weekly maintenance role.



Commitment: Approximately 2 hours per week (8 hours per month).



Compensation: $6 – $10 USD per hour (negotiable based on your level of expertise, structured as a reliable monthly retainer).



Core Responsibilities:

E-Commerce Reconciliation: Accurately log and reconcile Revenue, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), daily Meta/Facebook ad spend, and transaction fees across Shopify Payments and PayPal.



Banking & Credit Cards: Manage data feeds and manually resolve sync errors inside Xero for UK business accounts and American Express (Amex) cards, ensuring zero missing entries or duplicates.



HMRC Tax Optimization & Avoidance: Provide legitimate strategies to legally minimize UK Corporation Tax and Income Tax. This includes structuring Director Salary vs. Dividends under the £12,570 Personal Allowance threshold.



Family Payroll Setup: Advise on and execute tax-efficient structures for paying a spouse or family members as employees under legitimate HMRC guidelines.



VAT Application & Shopify Setup: We are approaching the UK VAT threshold (£90,000). You will be responsible for handling the official VAT application with HMRC, structuring our accounts for quarterly reporting, and ensuring Shopify’s backend sales tax settings are correctly mapped to collect VAT from customers flawlessly.



Expense Maximization: Identify all valid business expenses under HMRC rules (home office allowances, software subscriptions, equipment, phone/internet, etc.).

description:

We're hiring a full-time Community Coordinator to join our Marketing team. This is a LinkedIn-specialist, community-first role: you specialize fully in LinkedIn and own our community growth — the content calendar, the posts, the LinkedIn Articles, and the engagement — and you're responsible for the results. You'll manage 6 LinkedIn accounts of PerkUp's team members (including the founder's). Our senior content lead owns blog strategy and brand voice; you make our LinkedIn presence active and growing.

LinkedIn community growth

Performance & iteration

AI-assisted, human output

M&M Multimedia is a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in website design, development, SEO, hosting, and digital marketing services for small and medium-sized businesses.



We work with an established offshore website development team and are looking for a highly organized Website Project Coordinator to become the primary point of contact between our clients and our development team.



This is a long-term remote position with opportunities for increased responsibility and increased hours as the company grows.



## Who We're Looking For



This is NOT a typical Virtual Assistant position.



We are specifically looking for someone who has experience managing website projects, communicating with clients, coordinating revisions, and working with web developers.



You should be comfortable leading client meetings, gathering project requirements, managing timelines, and ensuring projects move smoothly from kickoff to launch.



If you've worked for a digital marketing agency, website design company, or web development firm, we want to hear from you.

### Client Communication

s

* Follow up on missing content or approvals

* Document all client communications and project notes



### Administrative Coordination

* Create and manage project checklists

* Excellent spoken and written English
