* Strong Zoom meeting and presentation skills

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

* Freshdesk experience

* Basic SEO knowledge

By combining industry expertise with advanced technology, data-driven market analysis, and streamlined systems, we identify investment opportunities and deliver fast, efficient transactions.

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Cold Caller/Real Estate Acquisitions representative. This role will be critical in acquiring and evaluating land deals, analyzing comparable properties, researching markets, and gathering data.



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.

• Make 100 to 200 outbound cold calls to landowners and potential sellers daily

• Identify motivated sellers and gather key property details

• Generate qualified leads daily

• Enter new leads in CRM or spreadsheet

• Schedule follow-up calls as necessary to keep the lead engaged to maintain the relationship.

• Create new leads in CRM

• Generate comparable sales for properties

• Market analysis and research

• Ability to price properties using guidelines

• If needed, coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, and attorneys

• Miscellaneous real estate-based tasks

• **Strong spoken English with minimal accent to communicate effectively with US-based clients**

• Experience with real estate, specifically vacant land acquisitions and land pricing preferred

• High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Takes full ownership

• Follows checklists

• Meets deadlines

• Communicate clearly

• Ability to learn and work independently

• Proficient in Excel

title: Amazon PPC Manager – E-commerce Growth & ROI Specialist
description:
Role Overview: We are seeking a highly analytical, aggressive, and results-driven Amazon PPC Manager to take full ownership of our Amazon advertising strategy and execution. In this role, you will not just be "managing campaigns"—you will be the driving force behind our profitability, revenue scaling, and market share domination.



We are looking for a strategic expert with a proven, verifiable track record of scaling Amazon brands while lowering Total Advertising Cost of Sales (TACoS) and maximizing Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). If you are a problem-solver who thrives on data, scaling budgets profitably, and measurable outcomes, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities (What You Will Accomplish):



Drive Scalable Revenue Growth: Architect, launch, and aggressively manage full-funnel Amazon advertising campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP) to maximize daily sales velocity and net profit.

Relentless Optimization: Continuously audit and optimize bids, search terms, and targeting strategies to achieve aggressive target ACoS and TACoS. You will cut wasted spend with precision negative keywords while scaling winning campaigns.

Keyword & Competitor Domination: Execute deep-dive keyword research and competitor analysis to identify profitable gaps, win top-of-search placements, and aggressively defend our brand share against competitors.

Strategic Campaign Architecture: Build and refine advanced campaign structures (e.g., search term isolation, auto-campaign harvesting, and custom budget allocation based on product life cycles and profitability).

Actionable Reporting & Forecasting: Go beyond basic metrics. Deliver weekly performance insights detailing critical KPIs (Spend, Sales, ROAS, ACoS, TACoS, CTR, CVR) accompanied by proactive action plans and growth forecasts.

Inventory Alignment: Collaborate closely with the inventory team to align ad spend with stock levels—aggressively pushing overstock inventory while throttling or pausing campaigns to avoid stockouts on top-sellers.

A/B Testing & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Continuously test ad copy, custom creative assets, video ads, and storefront traffic to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) and overall Conversion Rates (CVR).





Required Skills & Qualifications:



Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience independently managing high-volume Amazon PPC budgets ($50k - $100k+/month spend).

Proven Track Record: Tangible history of scaling accounts while maintaining or improving profitability targets. (Note: You will be required to share your best case studies).

Technical Mastery: Deep, up-to-date understanding of the Amazon A9 Ranking Algorithm, Amazon Campaign Manager, Brand Analytics, and advanced targeting features.

Strategic Mindset: Proactive problem-solver who does not wait to be told what to do. You stay ahead of Amazon’s frequent platform updates and terms of service changes.





Performance KPIs (How Your Success Will Be Measured):



Overall Revenue Growth at the brand level.

Strict adherence to benchmark TACoS (Total ACoS) and target ROAS.

Increased organic ranking velocity driven by targeted PPC conversions.

Reduction of wasted ad spend (Zero-sale search term mitigation).





Compensation & Perks:



Pay Rate: HIGHLY NEGOTIABLE. We believe in paying top dollar for top talent. Compensation will be tailored to your experience, direct track record, and the results you can deliver. We are open to a strong base salary, performance-based profit-sharing, or commission structures for the right A-player.



Fully remote work environment with flexible working hours.



Opportunity to lead growth for an ambitious and rapidly expanding brand.



How to Apply: Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter. With your application, you must include your best case studies detailing your past performance (e.g., how you successfully scaled an account, improved ROAS/ACoS, and the specific strategies you implemented to achieve those results).

title: Organic Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Organic Lead Generation Specialist who can generate real buyer conversations through social platforms, communities, comments, and direct outreach.

Your job is not just to create content. Your job is to find people who are already discussing relevant problems, join the conversation naturally, create interest, and move qualified prospects into a trackable lead path.



What You’ll Do

Reddit

Facebook Groups

TikTok comments

YouTube comments

X/Twitter

Forums

Niche online communities

Researching buyer-intent conversations online

Finding posts, comments, and threads where people are already asking questions or showing interest

Leaving useful, natural comments that contribute to the discussion

Starting conversations through replies and DMs without sounding spammy

Qualifying prospects based on problem, interest, urgency, and buying intent

Tracking all activity, links, conversations, clicks, leads, and conversion signals daily

Reporting what is producing real conversations and buyer signals

Write strong, natural English

Sound like a real person in online communities

Understand how Reddit, Facebook groups, TikTok, YouTube comments, and X work

Identify buying intent from comments and discussions

Start conversations without sounding like a marketer

Follow daily activity targets

Track your work clearly

Think strategically about where buyers are hiding online

Adapt your messaging based on what gets responses

This Role Is Good For You If



You enjoy:



Searching online for active conversations

Commenting and replying naturally

Starting DMs and building conversations

Testing angles and seeing what gets traction

Working with clear daily targets

Turning organic activity into measurable leads

This Role Is NOT For You If



This is not a fit if you only know how to:



Schedule posts

Make Canva graphics

Write generic captions

Wait for people to engage

Copy-paste spammy comments

Say “check my link” everywhere

Report activity without producing leads



We are looking for someone who can create real opportunities, not just activity.



Daily Targets



You will be expected to hit daily activity and lead-generation targets such as:



Find 20+ relevant buyer-intent posts, threads, or comments

Start 10–15 conversations or DMs

Track clicks, replies, conversations, and lead quality daily

Success in this role means:



Consistent qualified buyer conversations

Clear lead reports

Strong platform and angle testing

Sales opportunities passed to the team

Evidence that organic activity is creating real buyer interest

Experience with organic outreach, community engagement, lead generation, or social selling

Familiarity with Reddit, Facebook Groups, TikTok, YouTube, and X

Ability to research and find buyer conversations manually

Comfortable with daily reporting

Able to work independently and hit targets

Must understand the difference between spam and natural engagement

title: AI Automation Builder & Client Delivery Manager
description:
ABOUT US



GrowthAIgent is a US-based AI automation agency helping appointment-based service businesses — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, medspas, and clinics — recover lost revenue through AI-powered systems. We automate their front desk, eliminate no-shows, reactivate dormant clients, and build their client pipeline end to end.



We are growing fast and need a skilled builder who can take our four core services from concept to working system — and then own ongoing delivery for our clients.



---



THE ROLE



This starts as a focused build project across our four services. Once built and proven, the role transitions into ongoing client delivery management — configuring, deploying, and maintaining these systems for new clients as they come on board.



This is a ground-floor opportunity. You will be building the delivery infrastructure of a growing AI agency from scratch, with direct access to the founder.



---



THE FOUR SYSTEMS YOU WILL BUILD



1. VIRTUAL RECEPTIONIST

Configure and deploy a white-labeled AI voice receptionist for service business clients using Thinkrr (thinkrr.ai). The receptionist answers calls 24/7, books appointments, handles FAQs, and qualifies leads. You will build the configuration template, write the call scripts and FAQs, integrate with GoHighLevel CRM, and create a repeatable deployment playbook so new clients can be onboarded efficiently.



Tools: Thinkrr, GoHighLevel, prompt engineering



2. NO-SHOW REDUCTION

Build an automated SMS and
 reminder sequence that fires before every client appointment, dramatically reducing no-shows and last-minute cancellations. Sequences must be personalized, timed correctly relative to appointment date, and stop automatically when a client confirms or cancels.



Tools: Make (make.com), Claude API (Anthropic), Resend, GoHighLevel or client CRM



3. CLIENT REACTIVATION

Build an automated campaign system that identifies dormant clients in a CRM, triggers a re-engagement sequence via SMS and
, and drives them back to book an appointment — without paid ads. Sequences must feel personal, not templated.



Tools: Make, Claude API, Resend, GoHighLevel or client CRM



4. CRM BUILD & AUTOMATION

Build and configure a complete client pipeline in GoHighLevel for clients who have no CRM or are switching from a legacy system. This includes contact import, pipeline stages, automation triggers, follow-up sequences, and team notifications. You will create a standard setup playbook that can be replicated efficiently across clients.



Tools: GoHighLevel, Make, Claude API



---



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- Proven experience with Make (formerly Integromat) — you must be able to build multi-step automation workflows from scratch

- Experience with GoHighLevel — CRM setup, pipelines, automations, and SMS/email sequences

- Familiarity with AI APIs — specifically the Anthropic Claude API or OpenAI API

- Strong written English — you will be writing client-facing copy inside automations

- Highly organized and self-directed — you will own these builds end to end

- Able to document your work clearly so systems are maintainable



Strong advantage:

- Experience with Thinkrr or similar AI voice platforms (Bland.ai, Vapi, etc.)

- Experience with Resend or similar transactional
 platforms

- Prior work with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, medspa, or clinic clients

- Experience building client-facing automation systems for a US agency



---



HOW THIS ENGAGEMENT WORKS



Phase 1 — Build (project-based, paid per deliverable)

You build each of the four systems, test them end to end, document the setup process, and deliver a repeatable playbook for each. We will review and approve each build before moving to the next.



Phase 2 — Ongoing delivery (monthly retainer)

Once all four systems are built and proven, you manage client onboarding and delivery — configuring and deploying each system for new clients as they come on board, handling troubleshooting, and flagging anything that needs founder input.



The right person will grow with the business. We are building something real and we want someone who takes ownership.



---



TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application — applications without these will not be reviewed:



1. A brief description of the most complex Make automation you have built — what it did, what tools it connected, and any problems you solved along the way

2. Your experience level with GoHighLevel — beginner, intermediate, or advanced, and what specifically you have built in it

3. One example of an AI-powered automation you have built for a client or for yourself

4. Your availability (hours per week) and your target monthly rate for the ongoing retainer phase



We move fast. If your application stands out we will respond within 48 hours.
